summary: Parked-up kerb backing onto a building site; homes only across the road.
reasons: Backs onto building site, no homes

best_section.where: West kerb of York Street beside the building site, south of the kindergarten

drivers.seclusion: West side is a cleared construction site; nearest dwellings are apartments about 20 m across the road, kindergarten 14 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where several cars sit; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; site trucks may use it.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb; one 1/4P short-stay sign applies 7-9am and 4-6pm weekdays.

flags: Building site may mean weekday noise and trucks
sun_shade: Open to sky; no cover on the west side, trees on the east side shade the morning.
cannot_judge: Whether the site is built over soon
